text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary deploy 'release/opt-scheduler' -> Elevated 503s on /v1/embeddings (canary pool: eu+apac). Error rate spike 9.8% over 2m. Pager: eng-oncall. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-rollback :warning:
ashwin: Ack, looking. Pulling canary logs and kernel traces now.
maria: seeing 503s start ~5:41 UTC, mostly on quantized kernels on p4d nodes. Traffic mostly embeddings. No user-facing P0 alerts yet but internal tests failing.
ashwin: Confirmed stack: quant-kernel v1.2.9 loaded on canary -> OOM-ish traces then 503s. Reverting kernel not possible without redeploy. Suggest flip feature flag to route to stable variant.
maria: +1 flip the kill-switch for new scheduler flag: `ff:enable_opt_scheduler` -> false. That should route traffic to stable path.
ashwin: Flipping now via admin API. `curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY\" https://admin.redwood.internal/flags/enable_opt_scheduler -d '{\"value\":false}'`
incident-bot: Action recorded: feature-flag `enable_opt_scheduler=false` by ashwin. Metric watch started.
leo: Noted partial reduction in eu-west, apac still trending at 4% errors. Initiating canary rollback for the release (start rollback job). `redwoodctl rollout rollback --release release/opt-scheduler --target canary`
ashwin: Rollback job started. Watching pods drain and new stable instances spin up. Logs show quant lib mismatch on new kernel path, likely the root cause.
sara: Opening an incident ticket and tagging customer-impact. Ticket: INC-2024-0831, summary: canary caused 503s for embeddings, internal tests and some non-critical customer jobs timed out. No direct P0 customers reported so far.
incident-bot: Incident severity: SEV2. Notifying product + SRE. Escalation: oncall-next.
oncall-next: Acknowledged. Taking over for the next 30m. Quick status: flag flipped, rollback in progress, metrics indicate errors dropping. Plan: validate rollback completion, confirm no lingering 503s for >10m, coordinate with SRE to confirm kernel versions on stable pool, prepare postmortem stub.
maria: After flag flip error rate dropped to 1.1% in eu within 45s. APAC recovered to ~0.8 after rollback finished.
ashwin: Rollback completed. All canary pods replaced with stable image at 07:02 UTC. Baseline latencies and error rates back to expected. :white_check_mark:
leo: Verified no customer-facing 5xx spikes in last 15m. Running full integration suite to be safe.
sara: Noted customers contacted: internal partner teams only, advising ops to open any downstream client tickets if they see failures.
oncall-next: Handing off to follow-up oncall for postmortem and RCA. TODOs: capture kernel mismatch logs, save rollback timeline, link runbook steps in incident ticket, propose mitigations (canary kernel gating + early health probes).
maria: Adding logs to INC-2024-0831 and creating a short blameless postmortem draft.
ashwin: Save command snippets used during mitigation to the incident ticket for runbook updates. Example: `redwoodctl rollout rollback --release release/opt-scheduler --target canary && curl -X POST https://admin.../flags/enable_opt_scheduler -d '{\"value\":false}'`
oncall-next: Thanks all. Closing active pager. Please add any additional notes to INC-2024-0831. Will re-open if regressions appear. :thumbsup:
